import os, json
import numpy as np, pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
os.chdir("/agent/jobs/b4cc24f7-7d34-4678-9427-998ab6e19307/provenance")
sh=json.load(open("phd_shielding.json")); pk=pd.read_csv("pocket_DUOX1_vs_DUOX2.csv")
m=pd.read_csv("PHD_master_table.csv")
fig,ax=plt.subplots(1,3,figsize=(15,4.4))

lbl=["DUOX1 TM/NOX\nmodule (cis)","DUOXA1\n(cis)"]
val=[sh["TM_buried_by_PHD"], sh["DUOXA1B_buried_by_PHD"]]
ax[0].bar(lbl,val,color=["#31a354","#3182bd"])
for i,v in enumerate(val): ax[0].text(i,v+25,"%.0f A$^2$"%v,ha="center")
ax[0].set_ylabel("partner surface buried by the PHD (A$^2$)")
ax[0].set_title("A  Surface the PHD buries on its partners\n(PDB 7D3F, chain A PHD)",fontsize=11,loc="left")
ax[0].set_ylim(0,1900)

ax[1].bar(["without PHD","with PHD"],[sh["heme1602_sasa_noPHD"],sh["heme1602_sasa_withPHD"]],color=["#999999","#e6550d"])
ax[1].set_ylabel("solvent-accessible surface of outer heme (A$^2$)")
ax[1].set_title("B  The PHD does not cap the oxygen-reduction site:\nit occludes only %.1f of %.1f A$^2$ of the outer heme"%(
    sh["heme1602_sasa_noPHD"]-sh["heme1602_sasa_withPHD"], sh["heme1602_sasa_noPHD"]),fontsize=11,loc="left")
for i,v in enumerate([sh["heme1602_sasa_noPHD"],sh["heme1602_sasa_withPHD"]]):
    ax[1].text(i,v+0.6,"%.1f"%v,ha="center")

diff=pk[pk.dVol!=0]
ax[2].barh(["%s%d>%s"%(r.DUOX1_aa,r.DUOX1_pos,r.DUOX2_aa) for r in diff.itertuples()],
           diff.dVol, color=["#d73027" if v>0 else "#4575b4" for v in diff.dVol])
ax[2].axvline(0,color="k",lw=0.8)
ax[2].set_xlabel("side-chain volume change DUOX2 minus DUOX1 (A$^3$)")
ax[2].set_title("C  The vestigial pocket is the same in DUOX2:\n25 of 29 lining residues identical, net %+d A$^3$"%pk.dVol.sum(),fontsize=11,loc="left")
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
